articles.summary: FOURTH QUARTER HIGHLIGHTS Production of 140,064 Boe per day (53% oil), a 6% increase from the fourth quarter of the prior year Record natural gas production of 392,163 Mcf per day, a 24% increase from the fourth quarter of the prior year GAAP cash flow from operations of $312.6 million. Excluding changes in net working capital, cash flow from operations was $316.6 million Capital expenditures of $270.2 million, excluding previously-announced non-budgeted acquisitions and other items Free Cash Flow (non-GAAP) was $43.2 million in the fourth quarter.
